context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 出費/税関/駆けつけ/散々/利息/定時/月間/多忙

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、企業経営、出費と収入のバランスが命だ。
lines.en: Ren, in business management, the balance between spending and income is everything.
lines.style: Measured, professorial tone. Leans forward slightly. Opens with weight—not lecturing, but drawing a line under something essential. Calm conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 税関対応、複雑なんですね。
lines.en: So customs handling is complicated, then.
lines.style: Tentative, seeking confirmation. Quiet intake of breath before speaking. Not quite meeting his eye yet—processing what he's hearing. Respectful hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 現場に駆けつける機動性、組織にとって重要だ。
lines.en: The agility to mobilize and get out to the field—that's what the organization needs.
lines.style: Clear, declarative. Settles back slightly. A touch of emphasis on 「機動性」—the word itself matters. Not unkind, but unmistakable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 散々な状況、過去にもあったんですか。
lines.en: Have there been... brutal situations like that before?
lines.style: Careful phrasing. Soft curiosity beneath—he's asking permission to understand the weight of what he's hearing. Lean in slightly. No rush to the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。利息負担、月間で数億円規模だった時期もある。
lines.en: Yes. There were periods when interest burdens alone ran into the hundreds of millions each month.
lines.style: Distant, reflective. Eyes not quite on Ren—looking past into memory. Quiet, almost matter-of-fact delivery, which makes it heavier. Breath measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 多忙な毎日、定時で帰る難しさ、現場で学びます。
lines.en: On days like that, leaving on time isn't really possible. I understand that now—I see it every day at the front.
lines.style: Soft but steady resolution. No self-pity, just acknowledgment. Slower pace on the second half. Trails slightly—like he's speaking something he's just decided to accept.
